en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Abd al-Ala narrated to us. Hisham narrated to us, from Muhammad, from Mabid ibn Sirin. He said: We asked Abu Sa'id whether he had heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) mention withdrawal. He said: Yes, and he related the hadith with the meaning of Ibn Awn's hadith up to the words: It is destiny.
de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Abd al-Ala überlieferte uns. Hisham überlieferte uns, from Muhammad, from Mabid ibn Sirin. Er sagte: We asked Abu Sa'id whether he had heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) mention Coitus interruptus. Er sagte: Yes, and he related the hadith with the meaning of Ibn Awn's hadith up to the words: It is destiny. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Ubayd Allah ibn Umar al-Qawariri and Ahmad ibn Abdah narrated to us. Ibn Abdah said: He informed us, and Ubayd Allah said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, from Qazah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. He said: Withdrawal was mentioned before the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), and he said: Why would any of you do that? He did not say: None of you should do that. There is no created soul except that Allah is its Creator.
de: Ubayd Allah ibn Umar al-Qawariri and Ahmad ibn Abdah überlieferte uns. Ibn Abdah said: He berichtete uns, and Ubayd Allah said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, from Qazah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. Er sagte: Withdrawal was mentioned before der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), and he said: Why would any of you do that? He did not say: None of you should do that. There is no created soul except that Allah is its Creator. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli narrated to me. Abd Allah ibn Wahb narrated to us. Muawiyah, meaning Ibn Salih, informed me, from Ali ibn Abi Talhah, from Abu al-Waddak, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. He heard him say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was asked about withdrawal and said: It is not from all fluid that a child is formed. When Allah intends to create something, nothing can prevent Him.
de: Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli überlieferte mir. Abd Allah ibn Wahb überlieferte uns. Muawiyah, meaning Ibn Salih, berichtete mir, from Ali ibn Abi Talhah, from Abu al-Waddak, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. He heard him say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was asked about Coitus interruptus and said: It is not from all fluid that a child is formed. When Allah intends to create something, nothing can prevent Him. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Ahmad ibn al-Mundhir al-Basri narrated to me. Zayd ibn Hubab narrated to us. Muawiyah narrated to us. Ali ibn Abi Talhah al-Hashimi informed me, from Abu al-Waddak, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the same meaning.
de: Ahmad ibn al-Mundhir al-Basri überlieferte mir. Zayd ibn Hubab überlieferte uns. Muawiyah überlieferte uns. Ali ibn Abi Talhah al-Hashimi berichtete mir, from Abu al-Waddak, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), with the same meaning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Ahmad ibn Abd Allah ibn Yunus narrated to us. Zuhayr narrated to us. Abu al-Zubayr informed us, from Jabir. A man came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and said: I have a slave woman who serves us and waters our date palms, and I have intercourse with her, but I dislike that she become pregnant. He said: Withdraw from her if you wish, but what has been decreed for her will come to her. The man stayed away, then came and said: The slave woman has become pregnant. He said: I told you that what was decreed for her would come to her.
de: Ahmad ibn Abd Allah ibn Yunus überlieferte uns. Zuhayr überlieferte uns. Abu al-Zubayr berichtete uns, from Jabir. A man came to der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) and said: I have a Sklavin who serves us and waters our date palms, and I have intercourse with her, but I dislike that she become schwanger. Er sagte: Withdraw from her if you wish, but what has been decreed for her will come to her. The man stayed away, then came and said: The Sklavin has become schwanger. Er sagte: I told you that what was decreed for her would come to her. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Sa'id ibn Amr al-Ashathi narrated to us. Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from Sa'id ibn Hassan, from Urwah ibn Iyad, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah. A man asked the Prophet (peace be upon him): I have a slave woman and I practice withdrawal with her. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: That will not prevent anything Allah has willed. The man then came and said: The slave woman I mentioned to you has become pregnant. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I am the servant of Allah and His Messenger.
de: Sa'id ibn Amr al-Ashathi überlieferte uns. Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from Sa'id ibn Hassan, from Urwah ibn Iyad, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah. A man asked der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm): I have a Sklavin and I practice Coitus interruptus with her. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: That will not prevent anything Allah has willed. The man then came and said: The Sklavin I mentioned to you has become schwanger. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I am the servant of Allah and His Messenger. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Hajjaj ibn al-Shair narrated to us. Abu Ahmad al-Zubayri narrated to us. Sa'id ibn Hassan, the storyteller of the people of Makkah, narrated to us. Urwah ibn Iyad ibn Adi ibn al-Khiyar al-Nawfali informed me, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah. A man came to the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the meaning of Sufyan's hadith.
de: Hajjaj ibn al-Shair überlieferte uns. Abu Ahmad al-Zubayri überlieferte uns. Sa'id ibn Hassan, the storyteller of the people of Makkah, überlieferte uns. Urwah ibn Iyad ibn Adi ibn al-Khiyar al-Nawfali berichtete mir, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah. A man came to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), with the meaning of Sufyan's hadith. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us. Ishaq said: He informed us, and Abu Bakr said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Amr, from Ata, from Jabir. He said: We practiced withdrawal while the Quran was being revealed. Ishaq added: Sufyan said: If it had been something forbidden, the Quran would have forbidden us from it.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim überlieferte uns. Ishaq said: He berichtete uns, and Abu Bakr said: Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Amr, from Ata, from Jabir. Er sagte: We practiced Coitus interruptus while the Quran was being revealed. Ishaq added: Sufyan said: If it had been something forbidden, the Quran would have forbidden us from it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Salamah ibn Shabib narrated to me. Hasan ibn Ayan narrated to us. Maqil narrated to us, from Ata. He said: I heard Jabir say: We practiced withdrawal during the time of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him).
de: Salamah ibn Shabib überlieferte mir. Hasan ibn Ayan überlieferte uns. Maqil überlieferte uns, from Ata. Er sagte: I heard Jabir say: We practiced Coitus interruptus during the time of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Ghassan al-Mismai narrated to me. Muadh, meaning Ibn Hisham, narrated to us. My father narrated to me, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir. He said: We practiced withdrawal during the time of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). This reached the Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him), but he did not forbid us.
de: Abu Ghassan al-Mismai überlieferte mir. Muadh, meaning Ibn Hisham, überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte mir, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir. Er sagte: We practiced Coitus interruptus during the time of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). This reached the Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him), but he did not forbid us. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to me. Muhammad ibn Jafar narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us, from Yazid ibn Khumayr. He said: I heard Abd al-Rahman ibn Jubayr narrate from his father, from Abu al-Darda, from the Prophet (peace be upon him). A woman who was far along in pregnancy was brought to him at the door of a tent. He said: Perhaps he intends to have intercourse with her. They said: Yes. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I intended to curse him with a curse that would enter his grave with him. How could he inherit the child when it is not lawful for him? How could he use it when it is not lawful for him?
de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte mir. Muhammad ibn Jafar überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns, from Yazid ibn Khumayr. Er sagte: I heard Abd al-Rahman ibn Jubayr narrate from his father, from Abu al-Darda, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm). A woman who was far along in pregnancy was brought to him at the door of a tent. Er sagte: Perhaps he intends to have intercourse with her. They said: Yes. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I intended to curse him with a curse that would enter his grave with him. How could he inherit the child when it is not lawful for him? How could he use it when it is not lawful for him? Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us. Yazid ibn Harun narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us. Abu Dawud narrated to us. All of them narrated from Shubah through this chain.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us. Yazid ibn Harun überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn Bashshar überlieferte uns. Abu Dawud überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from Shubah through this chain. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Khalaf ibn Hisham narrated to us. Malik ibn Anas narrated to us. Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, and his is the wording. He said: I read to Malik, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Nawfal, from Urwah, from Aisha, from Judamah bint Wahb al-Asadiyyah. She heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: I intended to forbid intercourse during breastfeeding, then I remembered that the Romans and Persians do that and it does not harm their children. Muslim said: Khalaf said Judhamah al-Asadiyyah, but what Yahya said with a d is correct.
de: Khalaf ibn Hisham überlieferte uns. Malik ibn Anas überlieferte uns. Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns, and his is the wording. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Nawfal, from Urwah, from Aisha, from Judamah bint Wahb al-Asadiyyah. She heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: I intended to forbid intercourse during Stillen, then I remembered that the Romans and Persians do that and it does not harm their children. Muslim said: Khalaf said Judhamah al-Asadiyyah, but what Yahya said with a d is correct. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Ubayd Allah ibn Sa'id and Muhammad ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. They said: al-Muqri narrated to us. Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub narrated to us. Abu al-Aswad informed me, from Urwah, from Aisha, from Judamah bint Wahb, the sister of Ukkashah. She said: I was present with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) among some people while he said: I intended to forbid intercourse during breastfeeding, but I considered the Romans and Persians and found that they nurse their children in that way, and it does not harm their children at all. Then they asked him about withdrawal, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: That is the hidden burying alive of children. Ubayd Allah added in his narration from al-Muqri: “And when the girl buried alive is asked” (Quran 81:8).
de: Ubayd Allah ibn Sa'id and Muhammad ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. They said: al-Muqri überlieferte uns. Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub überlieferte uns. Abu al-Aswad berichtete mir, from Urwah, from Aisha, from Judamah bint Wahb, the sister of Ukkashah. She said: I was present with der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) among some people while he said: I intended to forbid intercourse during Stillen, but I considered the Romans and Persians and found that they nurse their children in that way, and it does not harm their children at all. Then they asked him about Coitus interruptus, and der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: That is the hidden burying alive of children. Ubayd Allah added in his narration from al-Muqri: “And when the girl buried alive is asked” (Quran 81:8). Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us. Yahya ibn Ishaq narrated to us. Yahya ibn Ayyub narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Nawfal al-Qurashi, from Urwah, from Aisha, from Judamah bint Wahb al-Asadiyyah. She said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), and he mentioned a report like Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub's hadith about withdrawal and intercourse during breastfeeding, except that he said: breastfeeding intercourse.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us. Yahya ibn Ishaq überlieferte uns. Yahya ibn Ayyub überlieferte uns, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Nawfal al-Qurashi, from Urwah, from Aisha, from Judamah bint Wahb al-Asadiyyah. She said: I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), and he mentioned a report like Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub's hadith about Coitus interruptus and intercourse during Stillen, except that he said: Stillen intercourse. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me, and the wording is Ibn Numayr's. They both said: Abd Allah ibn Yazid al-Maqburi narrated to us. Haywah narrated to us. Ayyash ibn Abbas narrated to me that Abu al-Nadr told him, from Amir ibn Sa'd, that Usamah ibn Zayd informed his father, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas: A man came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and said: I practice withdrawal from my wife. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Why do you do that? The man said: I fear for her child or children. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: If that were harmful, it would have harmed Persia and Rome. Zuhayr's narration says: If it were for that reason, it would not have harmed Persia or Rome.
de: Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir, and the wording is Ibn Numayr's. They both said: Abd Allah ibn Yazid al-Maqburi überlieferte uns. Haywah überlieferte uns. Ayyash ibn Abbas überlieferte mir that Abu al-Nadr told him, from Amir ibn Sa'd, that Usamah ibn Zayd informed his father, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas: A man came to der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) and said: I practice Coitus interruptus from my wife. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Why do you do that? The man said: I fear for her child or children. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: If that were harmful, it would have harmed Persia and Rome. Zuhayr's narration says: If it were for that reason, it would not have harmed Persia or Rome. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr, from Amrah. Aisha informed her that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was with her when she heard a man asking permission in Hafsah's house. Aisha said: I said: Messenger of Allah, this is a man asking permission in your house. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I think it is so-and-so, Hafsah's uncle through breastfeeding. Aisha said: Messenger of Allah, if so-and-so, her uncle through breastfeeding, were alive, would he enter upon me? The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Yes. Breastfeeding makes unlawful what birth makes unlawful.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr, from Amrah. Aisha informed her that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) was with her when she heard a man asking permission in Hafsah's house. Aisha said: I said: Messenger of Allah, this is a man asking permission in your house. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I think it is so-and-so, Hafsah's Onkel through Stillen. Aisha said: Messenger of Allah, if so-and-so, her Onkel through Stillen, were alive, would he enter upon me? The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Yes. Breastfeeding makes unlawful what birth makes unlawful. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Kurayb narrated it to us. Abu Usamah narrated to us. Abu Mamar Ismail ibn Ibrahim al-Hudhali narrated to me. Ali ibn Hashim ibn al-Barid narrated to us. All of them narrated from Hisham ibn Urwah, from Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr, from Amrah, from Aisha. She said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to me: Breastfeeding makes unlawful what birth makes unlawful.
de: Abu Kurayb narrated it to us. Abu Usamah überlieferte uns. Abu Mamar Ismail ibn Ibrahim al-Hudhali überlieferte mir. Ali ibn Hashim ibn al-Barid überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from Hisham ibn Urwah, from Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr, from Amrah, from Aisha. She said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to me: Breastfeeding makes unlawful what birth makes unlawful. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Ishaq ibn Mansur informed me. Abd al-Razzaq informed us. Ibn Jurayj informed us. Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr informed me, with this chain and the meaning of Hisham ibn Urwah's hadith.
de: Ishaq ibn Mansur berichtete mir. Abd al-Razzaq berichtete uns. Ibn Jurayj berichtete uns. Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr berichtete mir, with this chain and the meaning of Hisham ibn Urwah's hadith. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Urwah ibn al-Zubayr, from Aisha. She informed him that Aflah, the brother of Abu al-Qays, came asking permission to enter upon her. He was her uncle through breastfeeding, after the veil had been revealed. She said: I refused to give him permission. When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came, I told him what I had done, and he ordered me to give him permission to enter upon me.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Urwah ibn al-Zubayr, from Aisha. She informed him that Aflah, the brother of Abu al-Qays, came asking permission to enter upon her. He was her Onkel through Stillen, after the veil had been revealed. She said: I refused to give him permission. When der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) came, I told him what I had done, and he ordered me to give him permission to enter upon me. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us. Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha. She said: My uncle through breastfeeding, Aflah ibn Abi al-Qays, came to me. He mentioned something like Malik's hadith and added: I said: The woman breastfed me, but the man did not breastfeed me. He said: May your hands be covered with dust, or your right hand.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us. Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha. She said: My Onkel through Stillen, Aflah ibn Abi al-Qays, came to me. He mentioned something like Malik's hadith and added: I said: The woman breastfed me, but the man did not breastfeed me. Er sagte: May your hands be covered with dust, or your right hand. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me. Ibn Wahb narrated to us. Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, from Urwah. Aisha informed him that Aflah, the brother of Abu al-Qays, came asking permission to enter after the veil had been revealed. Abu al-Qays was Aisha's father through breastfeeding. Aisha said: By Allah, I will not give Aflah permission until I ask the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), for Abu al-Qays did not breastfeed me; his wife breastfed me. When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) entered, I said: Messenger of Allah, Aflah, the brother of Abu al-Qays, came asking permission to enter upon me. I disliked giving him permission until I asked you. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: Give him permission. Urwah said: For this reason Aisha used to say: Treat as prohibited through breastfeeding what you treat as prohibited through lineage.
de: Harmalah ibn Yahya überlieferte mir. Ibn Wahb überlieferte uns. Yunus berichtete mir, from Ibn Shihab, from Urwah. Aisha informed him that Aflah, the brother of Abu al-Qays, came asking permission to enter after the veil had been revealed. Abu al-Qays was Aisha's father through Stillen. Aisha said: By Allah, I will not give Aflah permission until I ask der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), for Abu al-Qays did not breastfeed me; his wife breastfed me. When der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) entered, I said: Messenger of Allah, Aflah, the brother of Abu al-Qays, came asking permission to enter upon me. I disliked giving him permission until I asked you. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: Give him permission. Urwah said: For this reason Aisha used to say: Treat as verboten through Stillen what you treat as verboten through Abstammung. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us. Abd al-Razzaq informed us. Ma'mar informed us, from al-Zuhri, with this chain: Aflah, the brother of Abu al-Qays, came asking permission to enter upon her, with wording like their hadith. It includes: He is your uncle, may your right hand be covered with dust. Abu al-Qays was the husband of the woman who breastfed Aisha.
de: Abd ibn Humayd überlieferte uns. Abd al-Razzaq berichtete uns. Ma'mar berichtete uns, from al-Zuhri, with this chain: Aflah, the brother of Abu al-Qays, came asking permission to enter upon her, with wording like their hadith. It includes: He is your Onkel, may your right hand be covered with dust. Abu al-Qays was the husband of the woman who breastfed Aisha. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb narrated to us. Ibn Numayr narrated to us, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha. She said: My uncle through breastfeeding came asking permission to enter upon me, but I refused until I asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came, I said: My uncle through breastfeeding asked permission to enter upon me, and I refused to give him permission. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Let your uncle enter upon you. I said: The woman breastfed me, but the man did not. He said: He is your uncle, so let him enter upon you.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb überlieferte uns. Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha. She said: My Onkel through Stillen came asking permission to enter upon me, but I refused until I asked der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). When der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) came, I said: My Onkel through Stillen asked permission to enter upon me, and I refused to give him permission. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Let your Onkel enter upon you. I said: The woman breastfed me, but the man did not. Er sagte: He is your Onkel, so let him enter upon you. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani narrated to me. Hammad, meaning Ibn Zayd, narrated to us. Hisham narrated to us with this chain: The brother of Abu al-Qays asked permission to enter upon her, and he mentioned something like it.
de: Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani überlieferte mir. Hammad, meaning Ibn Zayd, überlieferte uns. Hisham überlieferte uns with this chain: The brother of Abu al-Qays asked permission to enter upon her, and he mentioned something like it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. Abu Muawiyah informed us, from Hisham, with this chain and similar wording, except that he said: Abu al-Qays asked permission to enter upon her.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Abu Muawiyah berichtete uns, from Hisham, with this chain and similar wording, except that he said: Abu al-Qays asked permission to enter upon her. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Hasan ibn Ali al-Hulwani and Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to me. They both said: Abd al-Razzaq informed us. Ibn Jurayj informed us, from Ata. Urwah ibn al-Zubayr informed me that Aisha said: My uncle through breastfeeding, Abu al-Jad, asked permission to enter upon me, so I refused him. Hisham told me that it was Abu al-Qays. When the Prophet (peace be upon him) came, I told him. He said: Why did you not give him permission? May your right hand or hand be covered with dust.
de: Hasan ibn Ali al-Hulwani and Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte mir. They both said: Abd al-Razzaq berichtete uns. Ibn Jurayj berichtete uns, from Ata. Urwah ibn al-Zubayr berichtete mir that Aisha said: My Onkel through Stillen, Abu al-Jad, asked permission to enter upon me, so I refused him. Hisham told me that it was Abu al-Qays. When der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) came, I told him. Er sagte: Why did you not give him permission? May your right hand or hand be covered with dust. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Layth narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Rumh narrated to us. al-Layth informed us, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Irak, from Urwah, from Aisha. She informed him that her uncle through breastfeeding, named Aflah, asked permission to enter upon her, so she veiled herself from him. She told the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), and he said to her: Do not veil yourself from him, for breastfeeding makes unlawful what lineage makes unlawful.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. Layth überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn Rumh überlieferte uns. al-Layth berichtete uns, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Irak, from Urwah, from Aisha. She informed him that her Onkel through Stillen, named Aflah, asked permission to enter upon her, so she veiled herself from him. She told der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), and he said to her: Do not veil yourself from him, for Stillen makes unlawful what Abstammung makes unlawful. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Ubayd Allah ibn Muadh al-Anbari narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us, from al-Hakam, from Irak ibn Malik, from Urwah, from Aisha. She said: Aflah ibn Qays asked permission to enter upon me, but I refused. He sent word: I am your uncle; the wife of my brother breastfed you. I still refused to give him permission. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came, and I told him. He said: Let him enter upon you, for he is your uncle.
de: Ubayd Allah ibn Muadh al-Anbari überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns, from al-Hakam, from Irak ibn Malik, from Urwah, from Aisha. She said: Aflah ibn Qays asked permission to enter upon me, but I refused. He sent word: I am your Onkel; the wife of my brother breastfed you. I still refused to give him permission. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came, and I told him. Er sagte: Let him enter upon you, for he is your Onkel. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Zuhayr ibn Harb, and Muhammad ibn al-Ala narrated to us, and the wording is Abu Bakr's. They said: Abu Muawiyah narrated to us, from al-Amash, from Sa'd ibn Ubaydah, from Abu Abd al-Rahman, from Ali. I said: Messenger of Allah, why do you favor Quraysh with marriage and leave us? He said: Do you have anything? I said: Yes, Hamzah's daughter. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: She is not lawful for me; she is my niece through breastfeeding.
